gearbox.ponder.amplifier.text_1: The Amplifier can increase the power level of a passing laser by a percentage
gearbox.ponder.amplifier.text_2: It requires energy input from the side for any amplification
gearbox.ponder.amplifier.text_3: The amplification percentage can be tuned on its input panel
gearbox.ponder.attenuator.text_1: The Attenuator can reduce the power level of a passing laser
gearbox.ponder.attenuator.text_2: The attenuation percentage can be tuned on its input panel
gearbox.ponder.combiner.text_1: The Combiner can combine multiple lasers into one
gearbox.ponder.combiner.text_2: The resulting laser has combined power and color of all the inputs
gearbox.ponder.compressor.header: Using a compressor to process fluids
gearbox.ponder.compressor.text_1: The Compressor can process fluids into items
gearbox.ponder.compressor.text_2: It can be powered with a shaft from the side
gearbox.ponder.compressor.text_3: It must move clockwise from the right side
gearbox.ponder.compressor.text_4: Fluids can be inserted from the back
gearbox.ponder.compressor.text_6: Lastly, the output can be retrieved with a depot, belt or basin
gearbox.ponder.kiln.text_1: Kinetic Ovens process items by burning them with friction
gearbox.ponder.kiln.text_2: They can be powered from the back using shafts
gearbox.ponder.kiln.text_3: Throw or Insert items at the top
gearbox.ponder.kiln.text_4: After some time, the result can be obtained via Right-click
gearbox.ponder.kiln.text_5: The outputs can also be extracted by automation
gearbox.ponder.laser.text_1: The laser emitter is the basis of all laser machinery
gearbox.ponder.laser.text_2: It can be powered with energy from the back...
gearbox.ponder.laser.text_3: ... to emit a powerful beam in the front
gearbox.ponder.laser.text_4: The beam will destroy everything in it's path...
gearbox.ponder.laser.text_5: ... with the exception of some special blocks
gearbox.ponder.mirror.text_1: Mirrors are blocks that reflect lasers
gearbox.ponder.mirror.text_2: You can use a valve handle to adjust the mirror angle
gearbox.ponder.mirror.text_3: or a precision crank for fine tuning
gearbox.ponder.prism.text_1: A Prism can decompose a laser into it's RGB components
gearbox.ponder.pumpjack.header: Using a pumpjack to gather resources
gearbox.ponder.pumpjack.text_1: The pumpjack is a multi-block resource extractor
gearbox.ponder.pumpjack.text_6: The well needs to be connected to bedrock through pipes
gearbox.ponder.pumpjack.text_7: And the crank be connected to a shaft to power the machine
gearbox.ponder.pumpjack.text_8: The results can then be extracted from the well with a pipe
gearbox.ponder.sapper.header: Using a sapper to gather resources
gearbox.ponder.sapper.text_1: Sappers are machines used to sap fluids from trees
gearbox.ponder.sapper.text_2: You can power them with cogs
gearbox.ponder.sapper.text_3: And then pull the output fluids from the back
gearbox.ponder.spectrometer.text_1: The spectrometer displays a passing laser's color and power level
gearbox.ponder.spectrometer.text_2: When wearing Engineers' Goggles, the player can get more detailed information from the Gauge
gearbox.ponder.tag.laser_stuff.descripti: Machines that emmit or interact with lasers
item.gearbox.tau_cannon.tooltip.summary: Consumes _Geld Ingots_ to shoot tau particle beams
